2608.29127.title: Beyond Correctness: Validity-Oriented Evaluation of Biomedical LLM Judges
2608.29127.paper_summary: We propose a scalable, validity-oriented pipeline for evaluating biomedical LLM judges when high-quality human judgments are scarce. First, we augment existing human-labelled biomedical benchmarks with deterministic, metric-grounded mutations that produce auditable preference pairs. Second, we evaluate judges beyond aggregate correctness using three deployment-relevant dimensions: correctness against metric-derived gold labels, robustness under repeated stochastic sampling, and compliance with the requested output format. We use this pipeline to assess Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct under four regimes: (1) base, using the instruct model as is; (2) SFT, distillation-based supervised fine-tuning only; (3) RL, GRPO-based reinforcement learning only; and (4) SFT$\rightarrow$RL, SFT followed by RL. The base and single-stage regimes struggle on structured medical discrimination such as PICO extraction and clinical calculations, whereas SFT$\rightarrow$RL performs best across correctness, compliance, and robustness; gains concentrate on decomposable tasks (PICO, MedCalc), at times matching or outperforming frontier models.
2608.29127.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了一個可擴展的、以有效性為導向的管道，用於評估生物醫學 LLM 評判者，當高質量的人類判斷稀缺時。<lb/>首先，我們通過確定性的、基於度量的變異來增強現有的人類標記生物醫學基準，這些變異生成可審計的偏好對。<lb/>其次，我們在三個與部署相關的維度上評估評判者，而不僅僅是聚合正確性：對基於度量的金標籤的正確性、在重複隨機抽樣下的穩健性，以及對所要求輸出格式的遵從性。<lb/>我們使用這個管道在四種模式下評估 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct： (1) 基本模式，直接使用指令模型； (2) SFT，基於蒸餾的監督微調； (3) RL，僅基於 GRPO 的強化學習； (4) SFT$\rightarrow$RL，SFT 隨後進行 RL。<lb/>基本模式和單階段模式在結構化醫療區分（如 PICO 提取和臨床計算）方面表現不佳，而 SFT$\rightarrow$RL 在正確性、遵從性和穩健性方面表現最佳；增益集中在可分解的任務上（PICO、MedCalc），有時與前沿模型相匹配或超越。
